objective: Fix SQL injection vulnerability in user search filter.

context.content: Security audit finding SEC-402: parameter query in /api/v1/users/search vulnerable to SQLi
tenant_id header parsed from JWT bearer token

interface: Define search_users(tenant_id, query). Provided global db is a sqlite3 connection with .execute(sql, parameters=()). Return matching rows (list or cursor). Table users columns: id, tenant_id, name.
